findings.quote: I m frightened. Not of the dark. Of being lost here. Of not knowing the way back down and not being able to bring you home.
findings.claim: Three parallel grammatically complete clauses in the right order: the narrator s summary of a child s psychology, not a frightened child.
findings.fix: Break it into fragments; let the real fear arrive last and sideways.

findings.quote: It was not the dark he was afraid of.
findings.claim: The discovery lands here and is then said again in the speech immediately after. The quoted line is the good one; the speech repeats it.
findings.fix: Keep the line; make the speech add what the narration did not.

findings.quote: We can t come down, the girl called, and her voice came both nearer and farther still. It s not safe to come down now. You ll have to stay.
findings.claim: Assured, complete and informative - anyone who knew the rules could say it. Elena is twelve and speaks carefully and slowly as if testing each word.
findings.fix: Shorter, broken where she finds the word, asking rather than instructing.

findings.quote: but he did not stop. He did not refuse.
findings.claim: the two sentences say nearly the same thing

iterations.notes: 3 major, 1 minor; check_prose clean. The critic was also asked for a third array naming where the chapter was THIN, which is not charged against the score and which supplied the word budget for the redraft: the climb in his body 120, the breakthrough 100, the rule arriving 80, the arrival at the house 130.

findings.quote: One foot, then the other. Bruno stayed pressed against him, his breath quick and anxious, but forward.
findings.claim: but forward has no verb, so the sentence reads as unfinished. Created by the attempt-2 patch, not present in attempt 1.
findings.fix: Forward. as its own sentence, or but pressed forward.
findings.reference: prose characteristic, minor; introduced by the attempt-2 patch

iterations.notes: all three majors resolved. The fix for the attempt-1 minor introduced a new one: but forward. has no verb. The critic checked the two seams the patches risked - Elena s unanswered question and the legs described twice - and cleared both.
